name: Main Hall
directions: Straight ahead from the front doors, through the double doors.

name: Maple Room
directions: From the front doors, turn left and follow the hallway to the end; it's the last door on the right.

name: Cedar Room
directions: Take the stairs or elevator to floor 2, turn right, and it's the second door on the left.

name: Birch Lab
directions: Take the stairs or elevator to floor 2, turn left; the lab is at the end of the hall.

name: Café
directions: From the front doors, turn right; the Café is past the coat check.
